entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. For questions about an existing order, press one. For technical support, press two. To speak with a representative, please stay on the line.
Hi, I need to make a return for an order I recently received.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit support, my name is Bob. I can definitely help you with a return today. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I want to return the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF-8675309... yep, I see it right here. The VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered about 18 days ago.
That sounds about right. So, can I return it?
Absolutely, that's no problem at all. According to our policy, you have a full 90 days from the delivery date for a full refund. You're well within that window.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. I wasn't sure what the policy was for the new bands. So what's the next step?

I can see here you're one of our VIP members, so thank you for your loyalty. I've just processed the return authorization for you. I'm going to email you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, stick it on the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that was easy. Thank you, Bob. I appreciate the quick help.
It's my pleasure! Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, just getting that return label is all I needed. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
